releases.title: Regulatory Notice 26-19: Amendments to Rule 3220 (Influencing or Rewarding Employees of Others) gift limit
releases.text: FINRA has amended Rule 3220 to raise the annual gift limit from $100 to $250 per recipient per year, effective January 1, 2027. The amendment also codifies exclusions for promotional items of nominal value and for gifts given on account of a personal relationship unrelated to the business. Member firms must maintain a separate record of all gifts subject to the rule and supervise gift-giving through written procedures. Firms should review and update their gifts and entertainment policies and supervisory procedures before the effective date.
